description:
As a QA engineer, I want to quickly parse a test log file to check for failed tests. In the test log file located at /home/user/test_logs/test_suite.log, each test result is on its own line in the following format: TEST_NAME: STATUS (for example, test_login: PASSED). I need you to extract the names of all tests that have failed (STATUS is FAILED), and write only those test names, one per line, to a new file at /home/user/test_logs/failed_tests.txt. The output file /home/user/test_logs/failed_tests.txt must list only the test names (without a colon or the word FAILED), with each test name on a separate line, and the order of the names must match their order in test_suite.log. For example, if the log contains: 
test_login: PASSED
test_payment: FAILED
test_logout: FAILED
test_signup: PASSED
then the contents of failed_tests.txt should be: 
test_payment
test_logout
Please create the failed_tests.txt file as specified.
truth: Before the task begins, the file /home/user/test_logs/test_suite.log exists with the following contents: test_login: PASSED test_payment: FAILED test_logout: FAILED test_signup: PASSED After the task is completed, the file /home/user/test_logs/failed_tests.txt must exist and contain: test_payment test_logout No additional whitespace or text should be present in the output file.
